about_the_game:
Tu Lei was an ordinary high school student and a firm believer in a world governed by materialism. That all changed when he intervened in an assault by a local cult. By standing up for an innocent victim, he became a target for the shadowy organization behind them and was subsequently kidnapped. Drifting in and out of consciousness, he glimpses a frail girl in ancient attire, who mysteriously calls him... "Brother"?

When Tu Lei awakens, he finds himself trapped in a bizarre sacrificial ritual. In this desperate moment, they accidentally awaken a nine-tailed celestial fox who has slumbered for a thousand years: "Jade." At the critical moment, Tu Lei forms a pact with the celestial fox. Drawing upon her divine power, he manages to escape. From that day forward, his ordinary life is shattered, replaced by a magical - and chaotic - new life living with the Great Fox Deity herself.

All characters in this game are adults

A divine fox who calls herself the Nine-Tailed, foretold to bring great fortune to the world. Legend holds that she brings peace and prosperity, and that any ruler who earns her favor is destined to forge a mighty dynasty.

She claims to have slumbered for a millennium, only to be awakened by chance when her seal was broken. Despite her long sleep, her divine elegance and majesty remain undiminished.

Though a goddess, she is known for her benevolence. Surely, if treated with the proper respect, she would not respond with arrogance... right?

Tu Lei's classmate. A self-proclaimed "perfectly average high school girl (JK)." Bright, athletic, and effortlessly capable. She's typically carefree and informal, hopelessly addicted to a gacha game called "Brave Hunters Roundtable." She's direct, always repays her debts (and grudges), but couldn't care less about things that don't involve her. Loves Tokusatsu, gaming, and junk food. Yet, beneath this cheerful and straightforward exterior, she seems to be hiding another, unknown side from Tu Lei.

An enigmatic girl who appears repeatedly in Tu Lei's dreams. Her face is always clouded by sorrow, as if burdened by an unspeakable past. She wears strange, ancient robes and persistently calls Tu Lei "Brother."

She is an enigma... then again, can one even be certain that a girl from a dream is real at all...?

"Heaven's Fox Chronicles" is an AVG (adventure game) featuring full Chinese voice acting and exquisite character art, creating a deeply immersive audiovisual experience. Experience a lighthearted, humorous romantic comedy while simultaneously diving deep into a world shrouded in mystery and lore. Unravel the complete story, balancing moments of laughter with heart-pounding suspense.

In the game, every choice you make will influence the plot's direction, build emotional bonds between characters, and even trigger unexpected, absurd anecdotes. While building on the classic visual novel interactive model, this title innovatively incorporates a card battle system, making combat sequences more engaging and participatory.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains general adult content: sexy poses or costumes, violent content such as fights or kidnappings, potentially frightening or disgusting horror content, illegal use of narcotics
